Consistent with PROTOCOL §3 as frozen, so not a finding; the engine confirmation should price it if the comparison is ever made end to end.
P4's 1.3× rule is met by every replicate at every t (minimum 392/248 = 1.58), so the lead's OPEN status does not hinge on the replicate-0 convention.
